import sys
import re


def main():
    counters = [0] * 6
    slug_counter = {}
    for line in sys.stdin:
        line = line.rstrip("\n")
        if not line.startswith("#"):
            continue
        level = len(line) - len(line.lstrip("#"))
        if level < 1 or level > 6:
            continue
        text = line[level:].strip()
        text = re.sub(r'^\s*#+\s*', '', text)
        text = re.sub(r'#+\s*$', '', text)
        text = text.strip()
        if not text:
            continue
        counters[level - 1] += 1
        for i in range(level, 6):
            counters[i] = 0
        number = ".".join(str(c) for c in counters[:level])
        slug = text.lower().replace(" ", "-")
        slug = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9\-]', '', slug)
        slug_key = slug
        slug_counter[slug_key] = slug_counter.get(slug_key, 0) + 1
        slug_with_suffix = slug_key
        if slug_counter[slug_key] > 1:
            slug_with_suffix = f"{slug_key}-{slug_counter[slug_key]}"
        print("  " * (level - 1) + f"{number} {text} (#{slug_with_suffix})")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
